assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original vertical cover photograph for Horizons A1, a warm modern English coursebook for adult and young adult learners. Create a believable documentary travel photograph, portrait 2:3 composition. A young adult Latina woman in ordinary navy casual cycling clothes and a simple coral backpack, wearing a properly fitted bicycle helmet, stands relaxed beside a realistic modest city/hybrid bicycle at a wide safe coastal viewpoint. She is looking away toward the open blue Pacific horizon, in a natural three-quarter rear view, so there is no posed beauty portrait. Full bicycle and complete human figure visible including shoes; realistic anatomy and bike mechanics, hands naturally resting on handlebar, no complex action. A second bicycle need not appear. Low coastal hills, warm dry coastal ground and an enormous clear sky and sea. Natural late afternoon light with real imperfect texture, slight atmospheric haze, understated photographic grain, true daylight colors, no cinematic orange-teal grading, no glossy AI skin, no dramatic fantasy mountains. Composition: person and bicycle occupy lower right and lower middle; upper third is uncluttered pale blue sky; left side has quiet ocean and landscape suitable for live cover typography. The photograph itself contains absolutely no text, logos, branding, watermarks, borders or typography. This is a fresh original scene, not a reconstruction of any existing stock photograph.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fresh original photographic background for the Horizons A1 cover. The attached old cover is a COMPOSITION REFERENCE only: ignore all its lettering, colored graphics, branding and watermarks. Recreate its broad photographic idea in a new original photograph: a young adult woman with a mountain bicycle, seen in a clear SIDE PROFILE facing LEFT toward a vast blue mountain valley and distant ridges from a rocky high viewpoint. Camera at normal eye height. We see her SIDE and a little of the FRONT of her torso, never a rear view. Her face is visible in left profile, looking out at the scenery. She is wearing a proper dark bicycle helmet, a navy long-sleeved outdoor jacket, a magenta hiking backpack, and modest straight-cut full-length navy outdoor trousers, not tight shorts or leggings. Her jacket covers the hips. Natural relaxed posture beside the bicycle, one hand on its handlebar and the other lightly on the top tube; realistic relaxed hands. Full person and a complete believable black mountain bicycle with restrained yellow rim/frame accents visible, including both wheels and shoes. Keep her hips and buttocks unaccentuated: the visual focus is the mountain horizon, side profile and bicycle, not her body. Do not use the previous rear-view coastal composition. The woman and bicycle occupy the RIGHT half and lower two thirds, with the bicycle extending toward the center. Leave a broad open blue valley and hazy mountains on the left and an uncluttered pale blue sky in the upper third for live cover graphics. Portrait 2:3 composition, whole subject kept clear of all image edges with enough foreground below both wheels. Real documentary travel photograph, natural daylight, true blue distance haze and neutral stone textures, ordinary human skin and fabric, no beauty retouching, no artificial cinematic grading. No text, no logos, no watermark, no letter-like textures, no border, no drawn illustration. Make a fresh original scene rather than copying the same identifiable person or exact photograph.
assets.fiction_boundary: Illustrative original artwork; old watermarked cover used only as composition reference. No original photo pixels reused.

assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: a simple original transparent orange brush swash for the title area of the Horizons book cover. Reference image is the old book cover; extract only the IDEA of its orange painted field behind STUDENT'S BOOK and DIGITAL PACK, not any letters or existing pixels. Generate ONE broad horizontal warm ochre/orange paint stroke, color close to #ECA831, with a large quiet almost-solid rectangular center suitable for live navy typography. Shape ratio about 3.4:1. Left end and most of top/bottom are broad and nearly straight so it can extend flush beyond the left edge of a cover; RIGHT end has a restrained, natural bristle/frayed paint edge like a real wide flat brush, not saw teeth, arrows or a sharp polygon. Very slight realistic paint texture and tiny irregular edge wisps only; no dramatic splatter, folds, bevel, 3D effect, shadows or gradient. Genuine transparent alpha background around the swash, no white/checkerboard background. Absolutely no text, symbols, logos, numbers or watermarks. This is a subtle recreation of the old cover's graphic language, not a new decorative style.
